BiblicalUsage: Job says his tormentors tear up his path and hasten his ruin, with no one to help them or to stop them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Job's complaint is honest: when trouble comes, it feels as though the path itself is torn up under my feet, and only God can lay it down again.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
